person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually verified index row supplies only Evelyn S. Barnes, Box 37, and the archive location; rank and identifier are blank. Exact-name OSS, official-collection, employment, occupation, obituary, directory, institutional, and archival searches returned modern, genealogy, and property namesakes but no candidate linked to OSS, Box 37, and two corroborating identity anchors.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 37 to establish personnel status, full middle name, identity anchors, occupation, employer, and OSS chronology. No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified in the accessible sources reviewed.
